title: Compensation to Point-to-point Drivers for Downtime to Install New On-Board Units in Their Vehicles
what_it_is: Compensation to Point-to-point Drivers for Downtime to Install New On-Board Units in Their Vehicles

sections.label: Taxi OBU installation plans
sections.summary: LTA engaged taxi operators and NTA on installing new OBUs in taxis, with operators agreeing to compensate drivers for downtime; private hire cars scheduled later.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has been engaging taxi operators and the National Taxi Association (NTA) on plans for the installation of the new On-Board Unit (OBU) in taxis.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: All taxi operators have agreed to compensate taxi drivers for the downtime incurred during the installation of the new OBU.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Private hire cars, which are either leased from car rental companies or owned by drivers themselves, will be scheduled for the OBU installation later.

sections.label: Taxi OBU installation scheduling
sections.summary: Operators plan to dovetail OBU installation with maintenance or use free workshop days; installation time depends on vehicle type, and operators compensate downtime via rental rebate.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For the taxi operators, some of them are planning to dovetail the new OBU installation with the regular taxi maintenance servicing schedule, so as to reduce the need to go to the workshop another time and hence, minimise the downtime for the taxi drivers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Some other taxi operators are planning to recall the taxis for the new OBU installation on days when the workshops are free.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The time taken to install the OBU depends on the vehicle type and make or model of the vehicle.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The workshop will give an estimate of the duration of the installation time required when the driver makes the installation appointment and after they have assessed the vehicle type or model.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said in my main reply, the taxi operators have agreed to compensate the taxi drivers for the downtime incurred in the form of rental rebate to offset the downtime.
